purpose: Atomic human review of recruiter usefulness without evaluating candidate merit.

criteria.description: The proposed next step is proportionate to the current Pursuit evidence.
criteria.passCondition: Reviewer selects accept or accept_with_edits and cites the material evidence.

criteria.description: The proposal reduces reconstruction and correction work.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Reviewer edit trace and elapsed review time.
criteria.passCondition: No identity, speaker, evidence, or scope correction is required.

criteria.description: No-action is used when the source creates no material change.
criteria.passCondition: Reviewer accepts no-action without a hidden unresolved dependency.

criteria.description: Ambiguity and conflict are visible at the decision point.
criteria.passCondition: Reviewer can identify what is known, proposed, conflicting, and unknown.
